caption: The drawing depicts a single, full-length dress rendered in light sepia or beige tones. The dress features a fitted bodice with a wide neckline bordered by a delicate trim, and has short, voluminous puffed sleeves ending in ruffled cuffs. The waist is cinched, and the skirt is full, long, and gently flared with a slight train trailing behind. The fabric of the dress is decorated with a subtle floral pattern running vertically along its length. The dress is presented without a visible wearer, head, hands, or feet, and is centered on a plain, lightly-shaded background with no additional objects or scenery. A faint signature, "Louise Edwards," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Wedding Dress
